case.title: Set up deposits for new clients
case.subject: Deposits
case.text:
Hi! We keep getting no-shows from first-time clients. Can I make people pay a deposit when they book online? We don't have Stripe yet.

Chloe - Lash Lab
case.why: How-to fully covered by the payments & deposits article (connect Stripe, then require a deposit).

output.reply:
Hi Chloe,

Yes, you can require a deposit on online bookings, and you can set up Stripe as part of it. Here's how:

1. Go to Settings → Payments and click Connect Stripe. You can create a new Stripe account from there. Finish Stripe's verification, since payouts start once Stripe has verified your business.
2. Go to Settings → Payments → Deposits and turn on Require deposit. Choose a fixed amount or a percentage of the service price, and optionally limit it to specific services.

Clients pay the deposit on the booking page when they book. The rest is paid in person or online after the appointment.

You can also set a cancellation policy under Settings → Payments → Cancellation policy, which saves a card at booking so you can charge a no-show fee manually.

Please note that deposits are part of the Pro plan ($79/month). You can check or change your plan under Settings → Billing.

Slotwise Support
